items.quote: 5 Stars, Excellent Tree Service! I recently hired Joe's Landscaping & Tree Service to trim back several large trees in my backyard, and I couldn't be happier with the experience!
If I could give Joe, Dwayne and his crew 10 stars, I would. They did an extraordinary job on my trees and my neighbor's tree which kept encroaching on my property line.

It did not surprise me at all to see this company with nothing but 5 star reviews. After doing business with them I am looking forward to trimming or removing my yard of shrubs and trees, forever with their service.
